high_level_description: The image appears to be a movie poster for the film "Eileen." The poster features a dark, moody atmosphere with a focus on three individuals. The central figure is a young girl with long red hair, wearing a dark outfit with a red scarf. She is positioned between two older women, both of whom have blonde hair and are dressed in dark clothing. The older woman on the left has her head slightly tilted downward, while the older woman on the right looks directly at the viewer. The title "EILEEN" is prominently displayed in bold, yellow capital letters across the middle of the poster.
